title: Lightweight Reasoning Transfer via Chain-of-Thought Vector Projection
abstract: arXiv:2611.34183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transferring reasoning capabilities from large language models to smaller ones often requires extensive teacher supervision or costly student adaptation. We study projected cross-model Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Vector transfer, a two-stage approach that keeps both models frozen. First, we learn a task-level CoT Vector in the teacher using dataset-provided solution traces and final-answer supervision. We then train a lightweight linear projector to map the fixed vector into a smaller student's residual space. Student-side training uses only final-answer cross-entropy on a small subset of task training examples; it requires neither teacher outputs nor intermediate solution traces. We select the student injection layer and intervention scale on a labeled support set and report results on the disjoint remainder of each evaluation split. On GSM8K and MATH, the projected vector improves base students by 10.37-21.98 accuracy points across the eval

translated_title: 通过思维链向量投影实现轻量级推理能力迁移
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型的推理能力迁移到小型模型通常需要大量的教师监督或代价高昂的学生模型适配。我们研究了投影式跨模型思维链向量迁移方法，这是一种保持两个模型均冻结的两阶段方法。首先，我们利用数据集提供的解题轨迹和最终答案监督，在教师模型中学习任务级的思维链向量。然后，我们训练一个轻量级线性投影器，将该固定向量映射到较小的学生模型的残差空间中。学生端的训练仅在任务训练示例的一个小子集上使用最终答案交叉熵；它既不需要教师模型的输出，也不需要中间解题轨迹。我们在一个带标签的支持集上选择学生模型的注入层和干预规模，并在每个评估分割的互斥剩余部分上报告结果。在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，投影向量在整个评估中将基础学生模型的准确率提升了10.37-21.98个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出一种保持师生模型均冻结的轻量级两阶段跨模型思维链向量投影迁移方法，无需教师输出或解题轨迹，仅用少量数据的最终答案监督即可将大模型推理能力迁移到小模型，在GSM8K和MATH上提升基础学生模型准确率10.37-21.98个百分点。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a lightweight two-stage projected cross-model Chain-of-Thought vector transfer approach that keeps both teacher and student models frozen, requiring neither teacher outputs nor intermediate solution traces, and improves base student accuracy by 10.37-21.98 points on GSM8K and MATH.
